property_location: Veerapandi Pirivu, Mettupalayam Road, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

property.facing: South facing site, East facing main door

verified_facts: 3BHK Duplex Independent House on a 2.75 Cents plot with 1600 sq.ft built-up area., South facing site with East facing main entry door made of teak wood., DTCP approved property eligible for 75% bank loan., Pricing: ₹73 Lakhs without interior woodwork and ₹78 Lakhs with interior woodwork., Ground Floor features car parking (11' x 19'), living hall (16' x 16'), kitchen cum dining (8' x 16'), 1 bedroom (10' x 11') with attached bathroom (5' x 5'3"), and an outer bathroom (3'6" x 5')., First Floor includes 2 bedrooms (10' x 16' each) with attached bathrooms, an open balcony (5'6" x 10'), utility area, and terrace access., Located at Veerapandi Pirivu, 1 km from Mettupalayam Main Road, close to Immaculate School.

content_plan.style: Relaxed, authentic local property presenter delivering a fast-paced walkthrough in natural spoken Tamil.
content_plan.hook_strategy: Lead with prime location near Mettupalayam Road and attractive 3 BHK Independent House offer.

scenes.name: location
scenes.voice: Coimbatore Mettupalayam Road Veerapandi Pirivu-ல, main road-ல இருந்து வெறும் 1 km-ல ஒரு சூப்பரான 3 BHK Duplex Independent House விற்பனைக்கு வந்துருக்கு!

scenes.name: land
scenes.voice: இது மொத்தம் 2.75 Cents land area-ல அமைஞ்சிருக்குங்க.

scenes.name: builtUp
scenes.voice: 1600 sq.ft built-up area-ல ground floor-ல spacious living hall, kitchen, ஒரு bedroom, அப்புறம் first floor-ல 2 bedrooms வித் attached bathrooms இருக்கு.

scenes.name: facing
scenes.voice: பாத்தீங்கனா, இது South facing site, teak wood-ல பண்ணின East facing main door கொடுத்திருக்காங்க.

scenes.name: approval
scenes.voice: இது DTCP approved property, 75% வரைக்கும் bank loan வசதி இருக்கு. 7000 Litres water sump, borewell எல்லாமே ready-யா இருக்கு.

scenes.name: price
scenes.voice: இதுல முக்கியமான விஷயம் price தாங்க! Interior இல்லாமல் 73 Lakhs, interior woodwork-ோட வேணும்னா 78 Lakhs.

scenes.voice: நேர்ல site visit வரவோ, மேலும் details தெரிஞ்சுக்கவோ உடனே call பண்ணுங்க!
